card.name: Opening bracket or 'medical' starting a phrase
card.fires_on: The word 'medical' (or 'Medical') right after 'or', 'other' or a sentence start, and square brackets that open a reference or field label. Also 'Design' inside a registry field.

modes.label: Medical as a modifier
modes.description: The word medical begins a noun phrase such as medical literature, medical management, medical products or medical judgement.
modes.example: Initiate hormone replacement or<< medical>> management as clinically indicated.

modes.label: Opening square bracket
modes.description: A bracket that opens a cross-reference or a registry field label, or the word Design inside it.

card.plain: It fires on the word 'medical' when it starts a phrase, and on opening brackets before references or field labels.
